# Adibasi Tarzan Club

> Adibasi Tarzan Club (ATC) is a community football and cultural club founded in 1981 in S. Akhanagar, Kaliyaganj, Uttar Dinajpur district, West Bengal, India. It fields a first team in the District League, runs a youth football programme, hosts the ATC Annual Cup tournament and keeps Adibasi heritage alive through its cultural wing.

## Key facts

- Name: Adibasi Tarzan Club (also written Adivasi Tarzan Club; short name ATC)
- Founded: 1981, in S. Akhanagar, Kaliyaganj
- Location: S. Akhanagar, Kaliyaganj, Uttar Dinajpur, West Bengal 733129, India
- Home ground: S. Akhanagar Ground
- Sport: football (soccer), plus a cultural / heritage wing and community work
- Motto: "Rooted in the soil. United in spirit."
- Email: info@adibasitarzanclub.in
- Official website: https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/adibasitarzanclub, https://www.instagram.com/adibasitarzanclub, https://www.youtube.com/@adibasitarzanclub

## Latest news

- [Registration opens for the 2026 ATC Annual Cup](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/annual-cup-2026-registration): Clubs from across Uttar Dinajpur can now enter the 45th-anniversary edition of our flagship tournament.
- [ATC 3–1 Bansihari: a statement at home](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/atc-3-1-bansihari): Two second-half goals turn a tight league game into a comfortable win in front of a packed S. Akhanagar crowd.
- [Heritage Night 2026 — programme announced](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/heritage-night-2026): Traditional music, dance and stories return to the club grounds on 22 November. Performers and volunteers, sign up now.
- [Youth programme begins for the new season](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/youth-programme-begins): Morning sessions for under-13 and under-17 players restart at the ground every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
- [Hemtabad 0–2 ATC: clean sheet on the road](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/hemtabad-0-2-atc): A disciplined defensive display and two well-worked goals in a valuable friendly before the cup.
- [Ground renovation complete](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/ground-renovation-complete): New drainage, fresh lines and repaired goalposts — S. Akhanagar Ground is ready for the busiest month of the year.
- [New committee inducted for 2026–27](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/new-committee-inducted): The newly elected office-bearers took charge in a formal ceremony attended by senior members.
- [Under the lights: evening sessions return](https://www.adibasitarzanclub.in/news/floodlit-sessions): With the cup approaching, the first team moves to late training sessions twice a week.
